subject.title: All .large bubbles should have scrollable body regardless of truncation

question: Should native chat use an always-scrollable bounded body for every large/tall bubble, or preserve transcript scrolling and expose a bounded reader only for selected content or an explicit expand action?
rationale: Current code has no shared `.large` abstraction or established inner-scroll contract, and the choice changes touch, accessibility, and streaming behavior across two mobile UI frameworks.

options.title: Define a selective bounded reader
options.body: Specify height and content-type criteria plus an accessible expansion path, then implement the same contract in SwiftUI and Compose.

options.title: Always scroll large bodies
options.body: Adopt nested scrolling for every maintainer-defined large bubble and accept the cross-platform gesture and accessibility tradeoffs.

options.title: Keep transcript-only scrolling
options.body: Decline nested bubble scrolling unless a concrete mobile reproduction demonstrates a blocked reading flow.

recommendation.title: Define a selective bounded reader
recommendation.body: Specify height and content-type criteria plus an accessible expansion path, then implement the same contract in SwiftUI and Compose.

likelyOwner.reason: The available path history most directly connects this person to the current native chat renderer surface where the contract would be implemented.
